dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem: asymptotic behavior of $Q(s,r)$ when $s$ and $r$ grow together
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the asymptotic behavior of $Q(s, r)$ when $s$ and $r$ grow together (i.e., when $s$ is not fixed as $r \to \infty$).
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper resolves $Q(s,r) = (1+o(1))\log_2 r$ for every fixed $s$ as $r \to \infty$, but explicitly states in the abstract that the problem of determining the asymptotic behavior of $Q(s,r)$ when both $s$ and $r$ grow simultaneously remains open.
